# Phong Minh To · Texas Realtor (eXp Realty)

> Phong Minh To is a licensed Texas REALTOR® (TREC #843757) with eXp Realty, serving Vietnamese and relocating families buying homes in Dallas–Fort Worth and Sherman/Denison (Grayson County), Texas. The site is bilingual (English / Vietnamese) and publishes guides on relocation costs, property taxes and the Texas homestead exemption.

Contact: phone (737) 242-9999 · email info@phongminhto.com · booking https://tidycal.com/phongto

Disclaimer: all information on this site is for reference only and is not financial or legal advice.

## Guides
- [Texas Homestead Exemption Guide 2026](https://phongminhto.com/blog/texas-homestead-exemption-guide-2026/): how to file, the $140,000 school-district exemption (Proposition 13, approved November 2025), the extra $60,000 for owners 65+ or disabled, and the 10% annual appraisal cap.
- [California vs Texas: 5 financial differences](https://phongminhto.com/blog/california-vs-texas-5-khac-biet-an-cu/): cost-of-living and property-tax comparison for families moving from California.
- [First-time home buyer guide, DFW](https://phongminhto.com/blog/first-time-home-buyer-texas-dfw-guide/): five financial preparation steps for first-time buyers in North Texas.
- [Sherman TX and the Texas Instruments mega-fab](https://phongminhto.com/blog/sherman-tx-texas-instruments-mega-fab-real-estate/): long-term housing impact of the semiconductor expansion in Sherman and Grayson County.
- [How Buying a Home in Texas Works: 14 Steps From Pre-Approval to Keys](https://phongminhto.com/quy-trinh-mua-nha-texas/): 14-step Texas resale home purchase with a mortgage (TREC 20-19 contract, option period, earnest money within 3 days, appraisal, Closing Disclosure 3 business days before closing), in Vietnamese and English.
- [MUD and PID Taxes in Texas: Why New Homes Cost More](https://phongminhto.com/blog/thue-mud-pid-texas-la-gi/): Plain-language bilingual guide to Texas MUD taxes and PID assessments in new-construction homes: what they pay for, how they change yearly tax and monthly escrow (illustrative example), buyer notices required by Water Code 49.452 and Property Code 5.014, and how to look up a specific home.
